versions.content: If Master and Time Slave transmit Pdelay_Req for latency calculation with the cycle (refer to PRS_TS_00011 in [1, PRS Time Synchronization Protocol]), the following sequence shall be applied: 1. Get a free transmission buffer via EthIf_ProvideTxBuffer 2. Activate the time stamping via EthIf_EnableEgressTimeStamp if EthTSyn- HardwareTimestampSupport is set to TRUE 3. Trigger transmit request via EthIf_Transmit .
